apps.localizedDescription: Standalone multi-provider AI usage monitor for Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity, Grok, Google AI Studio, and OpenCode Go with secure local credential storage and device pairing.
apps.versionDescription:
Account cards list a provider's saved limit resets when that account has one. Open Limit resets to see what each one clears and when it expires. Claude and ChatGPT accounts can use one after a confirmation. Grok accounts list theirs, and redeeming stays on grok.com.
On desktop account cards, the spacing above each usage progress bar is adjusted to 4px, visually balancing the top gap with the 6px space below the bar.
On an open Limit resets row, the space under the pill matches the space above it.
Hovering the Limit resets row brightens the pill like Add account and turns the chevron the same colour as the Advanced chevron in Settings.
At the bottom of the sidebar, there is 16px above "All accounts updated" and 16px below the elapsed time.
On account cards, the space under the Limit resets pill is 19px, the same as the space above the provider icon.
On account cards, the Use button on a limit reset turns red when hovered.
Under Limit resets, the note is a pill in the same purple as the plan chip and reads "Warning: This reset action cannot be undone!"
Signed-out accounts now display "Re-authentication required" as their error message instead of "authentication is required".
On account cards, saved limit resets appear as a pill in the same purple as the Add account button. It reads "You have 2 available Limit Resets," and the number matches how many that account has.
Antigravity account cards and Usage charts now label Gemini 4 Carbon as "Carbon" and "Carbon Models", matching Argon.
Claude account cards now display the dedicated 7-day Fable limit ("7-day Fable") when returned by Anthropic for accounts with Fable access.
The sync status at the bottom of the sidebar now reads "All accounts updated:" instead of "All accounts synced:".
On the Usage page, each reset line shows how full that week was, just above the line.
On the Usage page, a day's tooltip says how much was used, such as "Nov 1: 63% used". An estimated day adds "Estimated bc data didn't refresh" and, on the next line, "for part of this day".
In Usage Notifications, the limits are named "5-Hour Limit", "7-Day Limit", and "30-Day Limit", and on phones "Limit" always sits on its own line below the window duration. The threshold menu is only as wide as its options, a hovered option highlights the whole row, and the check mark has the same space on both sides.
On the Usage page, an empty account list offers the same choices as the Dashboard — Claude, Antigravity, ChatGPT, Grok, Other, and Link Devices — instead of one Add account button. "No accounts yet" has equal space above and below it, and the picker starts at the same height as on the Dashboard. The Usage page describes it as "Add an account to see how much of its weekly limit you use each day." The Dashboard describes it as "Add an account to begin monitoring its usage limits."
On the Usage page, the provider icon, account name, and total usage percentage align at the top of the card header with the period label below the percentage, giving the email and date/time details lines full width extending up to the percentage without premature truncation or wrapping, and keeping tight spacing above plan and model details.
The keyboard shortcut to show the Dashboard page is now ⌘D / Ctrl+D (labeled "Show the Dashboard page"), and Add an account now additionally supports ⌘A / Ctrl+A alongside ⌘N / Ctrl+N.
On phones, the Usage card icon size and padding now match the right edge symmetrically so content aligns evenly across both sides of the card.
In the sidebar, the alert dot now aligns directly next to the provider name on the left instead of floating over the icon.
On phones, the sidebar list's left padding now matches the right padding so cards sit evenly within the drawer.
On phones, account error messages and retry actions replace the timestamp in the header instead of rendering a separate banner below it.
Sidebar meter progress bars now display the same purple gradient as account cards for healthy quota levels.
On phones, the % Left / % Used switch now appears only on the All Accounts page, keeping individual provider pages clean.
In the sidebar, an empty Accounts list says "No accounts yet", the same way an empty Groups list says "No groups yet".
On phones, the Dashboard's % Left / % Used switch matches the Usage page's 7D / 30D switch: the same height, rounded track, and inset selected option.
A closed Limit resets row no longer draws a line under the label. The card edge is the bottom of that row. The line comes back when the list is open, between the label and the resets.
On the Usage page, reset lines are the reset times the provider recorded. A weekly limit also shows the one week before its latest reset when that week was not recorded. Older resets are not guessed, and a usage drop does not add a line.
